quality_bandwidth: distance to kth visible quality neighbor, minimum 1e-6
behavior_bandwidth: maximum behavior distance inside the same quality-local neighborhood, minimum 1e-6
neighborhood: previously selected Refine parents only; current parent excluded; all prior attempts retained
missing_behavior: QB falls back to the same-time Q prediction; complete-profile subset reported
permutation_unit: shuffle behavior weights among parent identities inside each query's quality-local neighborhood
increment_gate: QB macro Brier relative reduction >=2%; >=3/5 tasks improve; macro log loss nonworse; real QB macro Brier beats >=95% of permutations
interpretation: post-hoc follow-up motivated by E1-A; does not revise the E1-A primary result
